symbols.name: exponent saving
symbols.meaning: A specific positive constant; the main theorem's time bound has logarithmic exponent $1-\kappa$.
symbols.quote: The main theorem gives one fixed machine with $T_A(n) = O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ for a specific constant $\kappa > 0$.

relations.quote: The conjecture bounds the cost of [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md) from below.
The conjecture is negated through the [limit inferior](limit-inferior.md) of $T_A(n)/(n\lg n)$, which must be zero for some machine $A$.
